@Roth.indexSet_nonempty : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B : ℝ},
  1 ≤ B → ∀ (q r : σ → ℕ), (Roth.indexSet B q r).Nonempty

theorem Roth.indexSet_nonempty.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B : ℝ},
  1 ≤ B → ∀ (q r : σ → ℕ), (Roth.indexSet B q r).Nonempty :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] {B} hB q r ↦
  Exists.intro (Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) 1) (fun j ↦ ↑((fun x ↦ 1) j) / ↑(q j)) r)
    (Exists.intro 1 ⟨Roth.one_mem_RSet hB r, Exists.intro (fun x ↦ 1) ⟨fun x ↦ isCoprime_one_left, rfl⟩⟩)
